produit: The Work Number, base de verification d'emploi et de revenus

2016.extrait: The database is approaching 300 million current and historic employment records at December 31, 2016.

2017.extrait: The database is approaching 330 million current and historic employment records at December 31, 2017.

2018.extrait: The Work Number database is approaching 380 million current and historic employment records at December 31, 2018.

2019.extrait: The Work Number database is approaching 380 million current and historic employment records at December 31, 2019.

2020.extrait: The Work Number database is over 460 million current and historic employment records at December 31, 2020.

2021.extrait: The Work Number database held over 535 million current and historic employment records at December 31, 2021.

2022.extrait: The Work Number database held over 600 million current and historic employment records at December 31, 2022.

2023.extrait: The Work Number database held about 168 million current and 657 million total (current and historic) employment records at December 31, 2023.

2024.extrait: The Work Number held about 188 million active and 734 million total (active and historic) employment records at December 31, 2024.

2025.extrait: The Work Number held about 209 million active and 813 million total (active and historic) employment records at December 31, 2025.

note: Exercice = annee civile, mesure arretee au 31 decembre. Serie complete 2016 a 2025, chaque point lu dans le 10-K de l'exercice concerne, aucune estimation. Equifax formule les premieres annees de facon approximative (approaching, over, about) et publie 380 M deux annees de suite, en 2018 et 2019 : le palier est bien celui de la source, pas un doublon. A partir de 2023 le 10-K distingue enregistrements actifs et total : la serie retient le total pour rester homogene avec 2016 a 2022. Controle 2021 : le centre Tech Policy de l'universite Duke cite en avril 2022 plus de 535 millions d'enregistrements actifs et historiques, concordant. Controle 2024 : la circulaire de procuration DEF 14A d'Equifax indique 734 millions d'enregistrements totaux, concordant.
